narrative: OMX30 enters Monday with a bullish setup despite overnight Nvidia headline risk in US tech. European markets are leading with DAX and CAC both >+1%, and our 0.814% correlation signal is strongly positive. The index sits at 95% of 52-week range, +4.3% above the 200-MA, and MACD remains above signal with ADX at 27.6 signaling strong trending conditions. Yields have softened 33bp (4.843% on US 10Y), reducing refinancing headwinds for real estate, while gold and copper rallies provide direct revenue support to Boliden and industrials. Key risks: trade war escalation narratives (Trump-Putin rhetoric) and potential mean reversion given RSI at 59.42 approaching neutral-overbought conditions.
morningBrief: OMX30 set to open higher on European momentum and positive correlation backdrop (0.814% signal). Bull regime intact with index +4.3% above 200-MA and MACD above signal—watch hold of 3170 support (50-MA at ~3180). ADX at 27.6 confirms strong trending bias; RSI at 59.42 is neutral but approaching caution zone. Sector calls: Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo, Sandvik) benefit from copper/commodity strength and stable USD/SEK; Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken) supported by yield stabilization and NIM outlook; Pharma/Essity defensive play on geopolitical headlines. Key watch: Boliden on copper/gold tail—both positive. VIX down 9.52% is risk-on signal but keep eye on Trump-Putin rhetoric escalation. Oil down -4.85% is mild tailwind for consumers. US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET could trigger intraday volatility.
